Bill.BriefDescription: Revising the requirements for obtaining signatures on an initiative or referendum petition.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to initiative and referendum petitions; and addinga new section to chapter 29.79 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29.79 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person soliciting or procuring signatures for an initiativeor referendum petition governed by this chapter must disclose whetherhe or she is receiving compensation or other consideration forsoliciting or procuring such signatures by wearing a visible button orsticker on the front of the body above the waist that accurately states"Paid" or "Volunteer" in print large enough to occupy at least twoinches in width. (2) Prior to soliciting or procuring the signature of a voter on aninitiative or referendum petition, the person soliciting or procuringsignatures must: (a) Accurately describe to the voter the impact that the initiativeor referendum will have on the law of this state; (b) Give the voter a copy of the seventyfive word summary of the p. 1 SHB 1169measure formulated by the attorney general pursuant to RCW 29.79.040;and (c) Ask the voter if he or she is registered to vote in Washington,and if he or she has already signed a petition for the same initiativeor referendum. A voter is not required to display identification priorto signing an initiative or referendum petition.
